pages.name: Auth
pages.purpose: Login and registration page with tabbed interface supporting email/password authentication, Google OAuth, two-factor authentication, and password reset flow.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card layout with brand header, tabbed content area for login/register, and modal overlays for MFA and password reset.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit buttons show spinner during authentication requests. OAuth button shows connecting state.
pages.errorState: Inline alert banner displays authentication errors (invalid credentials, account locked, network failure).
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card on mobile. Tabs stack cleanly. Virtual keyboard does not obscure form fields. OAuth button prominently accessible.

pages.name: CompanySetup
pages.purpose: First-run onboarding flow where new users create their company profile with name, type, stage, offer description, target customer, and goals.
pages.layoutHint: Centered single-column form layout with progressive disclosure. Brand header at top, step indicator optional.
pages.emptyState: All fields start empty — this is a creation form.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during company creation API call.
pages.errorState: Inline field-level validation errors. Toast notification on server error.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Single-column layout works natively on mobile. Textareas should auto-expand. Submit button fixed at bottom on small screens.
validationRules: Company name is required and non-empty
At least one of offer, target customer, or goals should be provided

events.name: company_created
events.trigger: User submits company form and server returns success

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Primary workspace displaying company overview, agent roster grid, active workflows, task board summary, and pending action approvals. Central hub for all navigation.
pages.layoutHint: Multi-panel layout with sidebar navigation. Top section: company info card. Middle: agent grid and workflow list side by side. Bottom: task board summary. Floating AI FAB in bottom-right corner.
pages.emptyState: New company state shows onboarding prompts: 'Create your first agent', 'Set up a workflow', 'Add a task'.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton cards for agents, workflows, and tasks. Company info loads first.
pages.errorState: Toast notification for failed data fetches. Individual sections show retry buttons on failure.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Panels stack vertically on mobile. Agent grid becomes horizontal scroll. Task board collapses to list view. FAB remains floating.

pages.name: DashboardAlt
pages.purpose: Secondary dashboard variant featuring a spec editor with live preview, validation panel, and AI assistant panel for development-oriented workflows.
pages.layoutHint: Three-column layout: left sidebar for navigation, center for spec editor with live preview (split pane), right panel for validation and AI assistant.
pages.emptyState: Editor shows placeholder text with instructions. Preview shows blank canvas with 'Edit spec to see preview' message.
pages.loadingState: Editor loads with skeleton. Preview shows loading indicator while rendering.
pages.errorState: Validation panel highlights errors inline. Toast for save failures.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Panels collapse to tabbed view on mobile. Editor takes full width with toggle for preview and validation panels.
validationRules: Spec content must be valid JSON or schema format

events.name: spec_edited
events.trigger: User modifies spec content in editor

events.name: preview_refreshed
events.trigger: Live preview updates after spec edit

pages.name: TaskBoard
pages.purpose: Full-page kanban-style task management board with drag-and-drop, task creation, filtering, subtask support, and agent assignment.
pages.layoutHint: Full-width kanban board with columns for each status (todo, in_progress, review, done). Filter bar at top. Create button in header. Task detail modal on card click.
pages.emptyState: Empty board shows 'No tasks yet' message with prominent 'Create your first task' call-to-action button.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton columns with placeholder cards. Column headers visible immediately.
pages.errorState: Toast notification on failed task operations. Drag-and-drop reverts on save failure.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Kanban columns become horizontal swipeable panels. Task cards show condensed view. Create button floats at bottom.
validationRules: Task title is required and non-empty
Priority must be one of: low, medium, high, critical
Status must be one of: todo, in_progress, review, done
Due date must be in the future when set
Assigned agent must exist in company

events.name: task_assigned
events.trigger: User assigns task to an agent

events.name: task_status_changed
events.trigger: User moves task to different column or changes status

pages.name: AgentChat
pages.purpose: Interactive conversational interface with AI agents. Supports model selection, conversation history sidebar, message streaming, and API key configuration.
pages.layoutHint: Two-panel layout: left sidebar with conversation list and agent selector, right panel with chat messages and input. Model selector in header. API key dialog as modal overlay.
pages.emptyState: No messages state shows agent greeting with suggested prompts. Conversation sidebar shows 'No conversations yet'.
pages.loadingState: Typing indicator while agent generates response. Message list shows skeleton on initial load.
pages.errorState: Failed message shows retry button inline. API key errors show configuration dialog. Network errors show reconnect prompt.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Conversation sidebar becomes slide-out drawer. Message input sticks to bottom above keyboard. Model selector moves to overflow menu.
validationRules: API key must be non-empty when saving
Model must be one of available models

events.name: message_sent
events.trigger: User sends a message to the agent

events.name: conversation_started
events.trigger: User opens a new conversation with an agent

pages.name: AgentProgramming
pages.purpose: Agent configuration interface for editing personality, behavioral instructions, knowledge base sources (files, URLs), and previewing agent behavior.
pages.layoutHint: Two-column layout: left side with tabbed instruction editor and knowledge sources, right side with agent preview card showing live updates.
pages.emptyState: New agent shows template instructions with placeholder text. Knowledge base shows 'Add your first source' prompt.
pages.loadingState: Agent data loads with skeleton form. Preview card shows loading state.
pages.errorState: Save failure shows toast with retry. Invalid URL shows inline validation error. File upload failure shows error with retry.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Columns stack vertically. Preview card moves to top as collapsible summary. Tabs remain accessible. File upload uses native picker.
validationRules: Knowledge source URLs must be valid format
Uploaded files must be under size limit

events.name: knowledge_source_changed
events.trigger: User adds or removes a knowledge source

events.name: agent_tested
events.trigger: User tests agent with preview interaction

events.name: agent_icon_changed
events.trigger: User selects a different agent icon

pages.name: Analytics
pages.purpose: Performance analytics dashboard showing agent effectiveness, task completion trends, task distribution, and time-range filtering.
pages.layoutHint: Dashboard grid layout with time range selector at top. Two charts side-by-side in first row (agent performance, task completion). Distribution chart full-width below.
pages.emptyState: No data state shows 'Complete some tasks to see analytics' with link to task board.
pages.loadingState: Chart areas show skeleton placeholders with loading spinners. Time range selector loads immediately.
pages.errorState: Failed chart shows 'Unable to load analytics' with retry button. Partial failures show available data with warning.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Charts stack vertically. Time range selector becomes dropdown. Charts resize responsively. Touch-friendly tooltips.

events.name: time_range_changed
events.trigger: User selects a different time range

pages.name: CRM
pages.purpose: Customer relationship management with tabbed views for contacts, deals, and activities. Full CRUD operations, search, and status management.
pages.layoutHint: Tabbed layout with three tabs: Contacts, Deals, Activities. Each tab has search bar at top, list view below, and slide-out form for create/edit. Status badges inline on list items.
pages.emptyState: Each tab shows specific empty state: 'No contacts yet — add your first contact', 'No deals in pipeline', 'No activities logged'.
pages.loadingState: List shows skeleton rows. Tabs load independently. Search shows loading indicator.
pages.errorState: Failed CRUD operations show toast with error message. List shows retry button on fetch failure.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Tabs become scrollable horizontal strip. List items show condensed view. Forms open as full-screen modals. Search bar collapses to icon on scroll.
validationRules: Contact email must be valid format when provided
Deal value must be a positive number
Deal stage must be one of: lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, closed_won, closed_lost

pages.name: Documents
pages.purpose: Document and folder management system with hierarchical navigation, tagging, search, and CRUD operations for documents and folders.
pages.layoutHint: Single-column layout with search bar and breadcrumb navigation at top. Folder list above document list. Create buttons in header area. Tag badges inline on document items.
pages.emptyState: Root folder shows 'No documents yet' with create document and create folder buttons prominently displayed.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton rows for document and folder lists. Breadcrumb loads immediately. Search shows loading indicator.
pages.errorState: Toast notification for failed operations. Delete shows confirmation dialog. Failed fetch shows retry button.
pages.mobileConsiderations: List view optimized for touch. Breadcrumb truncates with ellipsis for deep paths. Create buttons in floating action button. Swipe gestures for delete/edit.
validationRules: Folder name must be unique within parent folder

pages.name: Integrations
pages.purpose: External tool connection management page. Currently supports Gmail OAuth integration with coming-soon placeholders for Notion, Slack, and other services.
pages.layoutHint: Single-column card layout. Active integrations at top with connect/disconnect buttons. Benefits section below. Coming soon section at bottom with greyed-out cards.
pages.emptyState: No integrations connected state shows benefits of connecting services with prominent Gmail connect button.
pages.loadingState: Integration status badges show loading spinner while checking connection status.
pages.errorState: OAuth failure shows error toast with retry. Disconnect failure shows confirmation with error message.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Cards stack full-width. Connect buttons are prominent and touch-friendly. Benefits list collapses to accordion.

pages.name: Notifications
pages.purpose: Notification center with tabbed filtering (all, unread), mark-as-read, delete, and bulk operations for system and agent notifications.
pages.layoutHint: Single-column list layout with tabs at top (All, Unread). Each notification is a card with type icon, message, timestamp, and action buttons. Mark all read button in header.
pages.emptyState: No notifications shows bell icon with 'You're all caught up!' message.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton notification cards. Tab counts show loading indicator.
pages.errorState: Failed operations show toast. Mark-as-read failure reverts visual state.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width notification cards. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to mark as read. Pull to refresh.

events.name: notification_read
events.trigger: User marks a notification as read

events.name: all_notifications_read
events.trigger: User clicks mark all as read

pages.name: Settings
pages.purpose: User account and application settings with tabs for appearance (dark mode, compact view), account info, security (MFA enrollment, password reset, email verification), and notification preferences.
pages.layoutHint: Tabbed layout with sections: Appearance, Account, Security, Notifications. Each tab is a vertical form layout with grouped settings. Integration link at bottom.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — settings always have default values.
pages.loadingState: Settings load with current values. Toggle states resolve after Firebase SDK loads.
pages.errorState: Failed save shows toast with error. MFA enrollment failure shows inline error with retry.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Tabs become vertical accordion on mobile. Toggle switches are touch-friendly. MFA QR code scales to screen width.
validationRules: MFA verification code must be 6 digits

pages.name: Support
pages.purpose: Support request submission form with contact information sidebar and FAQ section. Shows success card on submission.
pages.layoutHint: Two-column layout: left column with support form and file attachment, right column with contact info sidebar. FAQ section below the form. Success card replaces form on submission.
pages.emptyState: Form starts empty with placeholder text in fields.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during form submission.
pages.errorState: Failed submission shows toast with error. File attachment failure shows inline error.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Columns stack vertically. Contact info moves below form. FAQ becomes accordion. File upload uses native file picker.
validationRules: Description is required and minimum 20 characters

pages.name: Tutorials
pages.purpose: Educational resource library with categorized tutorial cards, duration and difficulty level indicators, and tabbed category navigation.
pages.layoutHint: Tabbed category navigation at top. Grid of tutorial cards below. Each card shows title, description, duration badge, and level badge.
pages.emptyState: Category with no tutorials shows 'More tutorials coming soon' message.
pages.loadingState: Skeleton cards in grid layout.
pages.errorState: Failed to load tutorials shows retry button.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Card grid becomes single column. Tabs become horizontally scrollable. Cards show full width with adequate touch targets.

events.name: tutorial_viewed
events.trigger: User clicks on a tutorial card

pages.name: AdminDashboard
pages.purpose: Administrative panel stub for system-wide management. Currently minimal with header and content placeholder for future admin features.
pages.layoutHint: Full-width layout with admin header bar and content area below. Placeholder for future admin panels.
pages.emptyState: Shows admin placeholder content with coming-soon features list.
pages.loadingState: Header loads immediately. Content area shows loading indicator.
pages.errorState: Access denied redirect for non-admin users.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Responsive admin header. Content area fills available width.

pages.name: Login
pages.purpose: Standalone login page (secondary to /auth) with branding section, email/password form, Google and GitHub OAuth buttons, and forgot password link.
pages.layoutHint: Split layout: left side with branding and illustration, right side with login form. OAuth buttons below form separated by 'or' divider.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during authentication. OAuth buttons show connecting state.
pages.errorState: Inline error messages below form fields. Alert banner for server errors.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Branding section collapses to compact header. Form takes full width. OAuth buttons stack vertically.

pages.name: Signup
pages.purpose: Standalone signup page (secondary to /auth) with branding icon, full name, email, password with strength indicator, and sign-in link.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card layout with branding icon at top, form fields vertically stacked, password strength bar below password field, submit button, and sign-in link at bottom.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner during registration.
pages.errorState: Inline field-level validation errors. Server errors show alert banner.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. Password strength indicator clearly visible. Virtual keyboard does not obscure fields.
validationRules: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character

pages.name: ForgotPassword
pages.purpose: Password recovery flow where users enter their email to receive a reset link. Shows success message after submission.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card layout with bot icon at top, email input field, send reset button, and back-to-login link. Success message replaces form on submission.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible.
pages.loadingState: Send reset button shows spinner during API call.
pages.errorState: Invalid email shows inline error. Server error shows alert banner.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. Email input and button are touch-friendly.

events.name: password_reset_requested
events.trigger: User submits email for password reset

pages.name: ResetPassword
pages.purpose: Password reset completion page after email verification. Allows user to set a new password using the reset token from email.
pages.layoutHint: Centered card layout with key icon at top, email input for confirmation, alert message area, reset button, back-to-login button, and help links at bottom.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — form is always visible. Email may be pre-filled from reset link.
pages.loadingState: Reset button shows spinner during password reset API call.
pages.errorState: Expired or invalid token shows alert message with option to request new reset. Server errors show alert banner.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width card. All buttons and inputs are touch-friendly. Help links clearly tappable.
validationRules: Reset token must be present in URL

pages.name: NotFound
pages.purpose: 404 not found handler. Displays a friendly error when users navigate to a route that does not exist in the application.
pages.layoutHint: Centered single-column layout with illustration, message, and action button stacked vertically.
pages.emptyState: Not applicable — content is always static.
pages.loadingState: Not applicable — no data to load.
pages.errorState: Not applicable — this page IS the error state.
pages.mobileConsiderations: Full-width centered layout. Illustration scales down on small screens. Button remains full-width and tappable.

events.name: not_found_viewed
events.trigger: User lands on a non-existent route

events.name: not_found_home_clicked
events.trigger: User clicks back to home button

sharedComponents.name: Layout
sharedComponents.purpose: Application shell with sidebar navigation, top header bar, and main content area. Wraps all authenticated pages with consistent navigation and branding.

sharedComponents.name: TaskBoard
sharedComponents.purpose: Kanban-style task board with drag-and-drop columns for task status management. Renders task cards in status columns with reorder support.

sharedComponents.name: AgentCard
sharedComponents.purpose: Card component displaying agent avatar/icon, name, role, status indicator, and quick action buttons. Used in agent grids and lists.

sharedComponents.name: CreateAgentModal
sharedComponents.purpose: Modal dialog for creating a new AI agent with name, role, icon selection, and initial instructions.

sharedComponents.name: AiFab
sharedComponents.purpose: Floating action button that opens an AI assistant chat overlay for quick interactions from any page.

Authenticate user via Firebase token (OAuth providers)
Authenticate user via Google OAuth token
Create a new company for the authenticated user
List all agents for the user's company
Get single agent details by ID
Update agent properties (name, instructions, knowledge base, etc.)
Get conversation history for an agent
Send message to agent and receive AI response
Clear all messages for an agent conversation
Generate AI response for agent without user message context
Get tasks assigned to a specific agent
Get collaborative tasks involving a specific agent
Get performance metrics for an agent
List all tasks for the company
Get single task details by ID
Update task fields (status, priority, assignment, etc.)
Create a subtask under a parent task
Get subtasks for a parent task
Assign a task to an agent
Post a message/comment on a task
Get company-wide statistics (agent count, task counts, etc.)
Get analytics data with time range filtering
List documents with optional folder filtering
List folders with optional parent filtering
List available AI models across all providers
Check which AI providers have valid API keys
Generate AI response with specified model
Save API keys for AI providers
